misconceptions.description: Assuming a repository goes live automatically without selecting a Pages Source branch and folder
misconceptions.trigger: learner expects the site to publish without configuring Settings, Pages, Deploy from a branch
misconceptions.feedback: GitHub Pages only builds once you set a Source. Choose Deploy from a branch, then main and root, so it knows which committed files to serve.

misconceptions.description: Believing leading-slash absolute paths that work locally will also work on a project site served under a /repo subpath
misconceptions.trigger: learner uses href=/style.css and the CSS 404s on username.github.io/repo
misconceptions.feedback: A leading slash points at the domain root, not your /repo subpath. Use relative paths or include the subpath so links resolve on the live project site.

misconceptions.description: Expecting pushed changes to appear on the live site instantly and concluding the deploy is broken when they do not
misconceptions.trigger: learner sees the old page after a push and reaches for a destructive fix
misconceptions.feedback: Deploys take a moment and browsers cache. Check the build status and hard-refresh before assuming anything is broken or recreating the repo.

misconceptions.description: Treating a successful local editor preview as proof the published site works for visitors
misconceptions.trigger: learner verifies only in their own editor and skips the live URL
misconceptions.feedback: Local previews hide path and cache issues. Open the live URL in a private window on another device to test what a real visitor actually receives.

misconceptions.description: Believing a public GitHub Pages repository only exposes the rendered site, not the source files and commit history behind it
misconceptions.trigger: learner commits personal data or working files assuming visitors can only see the published pages
misconceptions.feedback: A public Pages repo is world-readable: every committed file and every past commit is visible, not just the rendered site. Keep private data out of the repo entirely.
